contractSummary: Complete H5 responsive, accessibility, visual, and regression QA for the local parent product. All routes must be directly reachable, 320px and wider must have no page-level horizontal overflow, fixed navigation must not cover content, and final tests/build must pass.
task: Run browser and automated QA, capture six 390px evidence screenshots, repair any discovered product routing issue, and document the result.
sanitizedDiff: Browser QA discovered that four dotted detail route files were nested under list routes whose components do not render an Outlet. The files now use TanStack trailing-underscore escape naming, preserving the public URLs while making /growth/records, /moments/:id, /guide/:id, and /me/baby independent root children. A route-structure test asserts the four public paths exist at the root to prevent recurrence. Browser checks covered 12 routes at 320x700 with zero document overflow; fixed product navigation had zero bottom gap and 96px main bottom padding, while auth pages had no nav and 40px padding. Six 390x844 loaded-asset screenshots were captured. A clean browser smoke across ten routes produced no console warning or error. QA documentation records source-provider constraints and screenshot evidence.
evidence: Route repair RED: browser direct visit to /growth/records rendered the growth parent heading instead of 成长点滴.
Route repair GREEN: route structure test passed and direct browser visits rendered 成长点滴, 阳光下的温暖时光, 宝宝第一口辅食, and 编辑资料.
Final typecheck: Vite build and tsc --noEmit passed.
Biome: 54 app source files passed; reduced-motion CSS emitted four intentional no-important-style warnings and no errors.
Responsive browser evidence: 12/12 routes had zero page-level overflow at 320px.
Visual evidence: six PNGs are exactly 390x844 with local images loaded.
Clean browser smoke had zero console warning/error.
